rules.description: Focused (F_) suites/methods should not be committed
Suite methods should use pointer receivers
Methods similar to lifecycle hooks (likely typos)
BeforeAll without matching AfterAll (resource leak)
Generated overlay files should not be in version control
Stdlib test functions — consider using gotest suites
testify imports — consider migrating to gotest
Outer t used inside Eventually/Consistently callbacks
Test methods not accepting *gotest.T or *testing.T
X_ prefix on a lifecycle hook (a no-op)
Cleanup/Parallel/Run via t.T(), Cleanup via b.B() or f.F() — bypass the suite lifecycle
Reads of a shared fixture the suite never declared as a field (only declared fixtures are started)
Shapes the generator rejects, where and as it rejects them
//nolint ids that name no gotest rule or golangci-lint linter
Suites/fixtures declared inside a type ( … ) block
Embedded suites, fixtures or hook-carrying types, and suite-typed fields of a suite or fixture
Direct calls of a lifecycle hook the harness calls
Simplifiable assertions (True(t, a == b) → Equal, …)
Nil/Empty on types their runtime guards reject
Assertions made redundant by the following assertion
if cond { Fail/Fatal(...) } guards — use assertions directly
Unnecessary t.T(), b.B() and f.F() convenience escapes (incl. Helper/Fatal/Log)
When("when …") / It("it …") — the spec supplies those words
A negative SuiteConfig/FixtureConfig timeout — every negative disables the deadline; say so by name
Benchmark methods that never call b.Loop()/b.N (nothing iterates, so the numbers lie)
Fixture-backed reads inside the measured loop (times the fixture, not the code)
time.Sleep/Eventually/Consistently inside the measured loop (times the wait, not the code)
Fuzz targets reading time.Now/math-rand/os.Getenv
Fuzz callbacks that assert nothing (panic-only)
Fuzz targets with no f.Add seeds
On-disk corpus entries for struct-typed targets (field-order-bound — delete them or write typed seeds)
IO in BeforeEach/AfterEach of fuzzing suites (hooks replay around every execution)
Raw []byte seeds on positions not taking []byte
